name: crypto-gold-terminal
description: AI-assisted crypto, gold and silver trading intelligence terminal (research and decision support, not execution)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @terminal/server" "npm run dev -w @terminal/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @terminal/web && npm run build -w @terminal/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
